sloka: निवेश्य सेनां तु विभु: पद्भ्यां पादवतां वर:।अभिगन्तुं स काकुत्स्थमियेष गुरुवर्त्तकम् ॥ २.९८.१॥
transliteration: niveśya senāṁ tu vibhu: padbhyāṁ pādavatāṁ vara:।abhigantuṁ sa kākutsthamiyeṣa guruvarttakam ॥ 2.98.1॥

translations.english: On encamping the army, lord Bharata, the best among men, wished to approach on foot Rama who was devoted to his father.
